question:
Select the option that rectifies the spelling error in the given sentence.

She is going to resiev a package in the mail today.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"resiev"** is incorrectly spelled and does not hold any meaning in English. (त्रुटिपूर्ण शब्द)
 
• The correct spelling is** "Receive"** means to be given, presented with, or paid something. (प्राप्त करना)
 
 
• **Example: **She is going to **receive** a package in the mail today.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **reseive** (त्रुटिपूर्ण शब्द): This is an incorrect spelling and does not hold any meaning.

 
 
• **Example:** Incorrect: She is going to reseive a package in the mail today.
 
 
 
• **resieve** (त्रुटिपूर्ण शब्द): This is an incorrect spelling and does not hold any meaning.
 
 
• **Example:** Incorrect: She is going to resieve a package in the mail today.
 
 
 
• **recieive** (त्रुटिपूर्ण शब्द): This is an incorrect spelling and does not hold any meaning.
 
 
• **Example:** Incorrect: She is going to recieive a package in the mail today.
